nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 23 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations updated at 07:07 and 08:01 WAT on 24 Nov. The published extrema preserve cross-source dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 23 Nov; mids read from the published buy/sell table.

Kenya.note: CBK Daily KES commercial-banks' average closing rates, 23 Nov. Not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 23 Nov; independently reverified through the SARB HomePageRates endpoint.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 22 Nov — latest independently verified CBE table; true effective date shown.

markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates (23 Nov); Kenya CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates (23 Nov; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (23 Nov); Egypt CBE official buy/sell mid-rates (22 Nov, true date shown).
